from: the tube's concept (K12.png), measured by score.stages.concept_people (accepted 2026-10-12): a man walking down the tube and a man sitting against its wall further on; a third figure the judge called a person stands behind the right-hand glass, outside the tube, like the reflection behind the left glass; each cast person stands at the plan's people spot (data/plans/tube.json `people`, read off the concept), set on the first solid under it at the floor's level and clear of everything by the cast stage's own ground and body measures
note: Two people, told apart by appearance against the made looks: both are dark-haired men in blue coveralls. The walker is the player (the made work suit is navy coveralls, the nearest of every made look); the sitter has no made look of his own: a kit look stands for him (kit_m_avg, the nearest build; its uniform is olive, not blue). The third figure is behind the glass, where the tube has no floor; it is not cast (it reads as a reflection, on the owner's list).

people.name: player
people.why: the player walking down the tube's walkway centreline towards its far door, through his plan spot, as the concept shows him; he stops short of the man sitting further on

people.name: sitter
people.why: a crew member sitting on the tube's floor further on, as the concept shows him
